question: If 20\% of a number is added to 72 , then the result is the same number. 60\% of the same number is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the original number be 100%.

Given: 20% of number + 72 = 100% of number.

⇒ 72 = 100% − 20% = 80%.

⇒ 80% of the number = 72.

⇒ 60% of the number = (72 ÷ 80) × 60 = 0.9 × 60 = 54.

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number added to 72 equals the number itself.

**Formula Used:**

Value = (Percentage ÷ 100) × Number

 20% 80% (Value = 72) 
• Total Number = 100% 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the number be x.

⇒ (20/100) × x + 72 = x

⇒ 0.2x + 72 = x

⇒ 72 = x − 0.2x

⇒ 72 = 0.8x

⇒ x = 72 ÷ 0.8

⇒ x = 90

⇒ 60% of x = (60/100) × 90

⇒ 60% of x = 0.6 × 90 = 54

**∴ The correct answer is 54.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To solve quickly, convert percentages to fractions: 20% = 1/5, 60% = 3/5, 80% = 4/5. Here, (4/5) × x = 72 gives x = 90.

Base Value Concept

Always identify the 100% base. If a part is given, the remaining part (100% − given%) corresponds to the added or subtracted numerical value.

Successive Percentage Formula

For two successive changes of a% and b%, the net change is [a + b + (a × b)/100]%.
